Setting up autofill
1. Turn on Autofill here and choose PassVault when Android asks.
2. In Chrome, open Settings → Autofill and passwords → Autofill settings, choose “Autofill using another service”, and restart Chrome. Without this, Chrome never asks PassVault.
3. Tap a username or password field, then “Unlock PassVault to fill”.
Other browsers that use Chrome’s engine (Edge, Brave, Samsung Internet and others) may have the same setting. Firefox asks PassVault without it.
